name: heavy-transport
title: Heavy transport (mission 4 required targets)
usage: Mission 4: three transports flying a route under jamming (required targets, never fire). Pending independent safety review; not uploaded; not referenced from src/.

noText.note: No letters, numbers, call signs, serials, codes or glyph-like marks in mesh or texture; grey countershading, splinter camouflage, panel lines, door outlines and stains only.

noLogosOrBrands.note: No company, product or brand marks; colour fields and wear only.

noRealMilitaryInsignia.note: No roundels, flags, national or unit markings; the only markings are a plain dark-red fin-tip band and plain rings behind the engine lips. Original design, not a copy of any real or game aircraft (cruciform tail on a high-wing four-turbofan transport, flat-sided fuselage, no winglets).

noFaces.note: No faces or figures: no crew is modelled. Head-on, the nose is a blunt radome in the body colour with no seam ring, dark panel or camouflage; the windscreen is a grid of small panes in body-colour frames, tinted only slightly lighter than the paint; nothing protrudes from the nose, cheeks or lower corners (no probe, pitot, blisters or gear sponsons). The four engine fronts are spread along the wings in a row. Checked in preview-front, preview-closeup-front, preview-closeup-front-3q, preview-front-low, preview-front-high and preview-closeup-front-low.

noSuggestiveShapes.note: Ordinary hard-surface or natural forms reviewed in all four previews.

noGoreOrWeaponsGlorification.note: Unarmed cargo aircraft: no guns, turret, missiles, pylon stores or bombs; cargo ramp and doors are closed panel lines. No damage or gore.

originalDesign.note: Authored procedurally in tools/assets from original dimensions; no third-party meshes or scans.

design: Original four-turbofan heavy transport: high wing with 24-degree leading-edge sweep and 3-degree anhedral, four podded engines on pylons, cruciform tail (tailplanes a third of the way up a 40-degree swept fin), flat-sided fuselage with an upswept tail and closed cargo ramp, gear stowed flush. Unarmed.
sizeRationale: 72 studs span x 68 long. The fighters are about 1.44 studs per real metre (26-stud Vanta for an ~18 m fighter); a ~50 m-span heavy transport gives 72 studs. That is 2.9x the Vanta v2 span (24.6) and 3.2x the Kestrel v2 (22.2), the same scale as the approved heavy bomber (72.7 span), so three of them read as large, slow targets beside the escorts.
reviewStatus: pending independent safety review (AGENTS.md); not uploaded; not referenced from src/

scaleReference.note: Review aid only: an approved, already uploaded asset placed at in-game size for scale. Not part of this asset or its FBX.
